# Rule template catalog

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by packages/shared/scripts/generate.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every template is built on one execution model: trigger → condition → action, with values
chosen from fixed slots. Price conditions always compare against the **last traded price**
cached from the most recent `Sync`; schedules are approximate windows.

| # | Name | Category | Trigger | Condition | Action | Slots |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DCA | trading | cron | timestamp_gate | swap | 4 |
| 2 | DipBoostDCA | trading | cron | price_below_previous_by_percent | swap | 6 |
| 3 | LimitBuy | trading | pair_sync | price_below_threshold_before_expiry | swap | 6 |
| 4 | TakeProfit | trading | pair_sync | price_above_threshold_before_expiry | swap | 6 |
| 5 | StopLoss | trading | pair_sync | price_below_threshold_with_trailing | swap | 6 |
| 6 | GridRebalance | trading | pair_sync | price_moved_from_reference_by_percent | swap | 6 |
| 7 | RecurringTransfer | personal | cron | timestamp_gate | transfer | 4 |
| 8 | IncomeSweep | personal | token_transfer | incoming_amount_above_threshold | transfer | 4 |
| 9 | BalanceFloor | personal | vault_balances | balance_below_threshold | transfer_from | 4 |
| 10 | DeadManSwitch | personal | cron | inactivity_above_days | transfer | 5 |
| 11 | PriceAlert | alert | pair_sync | price_crosses_threshold | alert | 2 |
| 12 | RangeAlert | alert | pair_sync | price_outside_range | alert | 3 |
| 13 | LargeTransferAlert | alert | token_transfer | amount_above_threshold | alert | 2 |

## Documented caveats

- **#2 DipBoostDCA** — No moving averages, RSI, or other indicators. The Agent caches one price per pair from the latest Sync and compares against that.
- **#6 GridRebalance** — A price band, not a portfolio ratio: the Agent cannot see the Vault's balances. The reference resets to the observed price after each fill.
- **#9 BalanceFloor** — Listens to the Vault's Balances event, not Transfer, because a Transfer carries an amount rather than a balance. The source wallet must approve the Vault once.
- **#12 RangeAlert** — Watches a price range, not a Uniswap V3 position. Reading a live V3 position is out of scope.

## Sentence model

Each template exposes a sentence with `{slot}` placeholders. The composer fills those
placeholders only from the slot list above, and the encoder maps the same keys onto the
on-chain `Rule` struct. There is no free-text, expression, or prompt field.
